alt: A sunlit café counter transitioning through autumn: walls shift from pale cream to deep charcoal, countertops from pale ash wood to dark walnut, white ceramic warms to rust terracotta, and the pastry case moves from light iced items to warm spiced pastries.
text:
the café notices first.

by september the bar is warm ceramic, dark wood, the smell of spice in the case. the surfaces speak before we do. it's not what we wear to signal the season—it's what the third place has already become.

#caféculture #autumnshift #thirdplaces
